source_text: Iabin rex Asor congregat reges aquilonis equos currus multos. Exeunt ad aquas Merom. Figuratur superbia et saeculi pompa adversus ecclesiam.
pass_a_gloss: Jabin king of-Hazor gathers kings of-north horses chariots many. They-go-out unto waters Merom. Is-figured pride and of-age pomp against church.
pass_b_english: [[Jabin king of Hazor gathers northern kings with many horses and chariots >> Bible:Joshua 11:1-5]]. They march to Merom’s waters. Pride and worldly pomp array against the church.
